tasks.short: Select and prepare medical equipment or medications to be taken to athletic competition sites.

steps.what: Read the mail that names the athletic competition sites
Read the kit protocol that states required medications
Read stored medication counts on the clinical record
Draft the shortfall of stored medications against the protocol
Select and prepare medical equipment for the athletic competition
Check packed medications against competition sites and the shortfall
Commit the accepted packing note for these competition sites

tasks.design: The kit protocol in {DOCS} states required counts, and {OTHER} holds the counts already stored. A draft subtracts stored counts from required counts, and the sports medicine physician still selects and prepares the kit. A later check accepts the packing note, and only then is that version committed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Required counts and stored counts sat in the same packing note, so a rule could not show a shortfall without also choosing the kit.
tasks.enabler_now: Required count and stored count can be subtracted as fields. Selecting the kit stays a separate human step.
tasks.still_hard: Many protocols are prose without counts. A missing count means no shortfall is drafted.
tasks.human_edge: Only the sports medicine physician can choose what equipment and medications go to the site. The shortfall does not do that.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays with selecting and preparing the kit. Less time goes to retyping the shortfall. No new right to choose the medications.

reach.task: Pack medical supplies for a competition site
reach.learn: Which stored counts a shortfall may subtract, and which kit the physician must still select.

evidence.claim: Required count minus stored count is arithmetic. That shortfall does not select equipment or medications.
A decision based solely on automated processing needs a legal basis. The physician selects the kit before the packing note is committed.
Works-council consent applies when staff performance is recorded. Packing the kit is not recorded.

assumptions: Means summed to 99.9. The two leftover points went to documents and then to meetings. The spreadsheet prior is folded into screens because the stored counts live on the clinical record.

The sports medicine physician writes the shortfall and selects the kit today, so every step's actor is the sports medicine physician. The machine is only the future fate of the shortfall and of the commit.

The protocol step produces required item code and required count. The record step produces stored item code and stored count. If the protocol is prose, the physician types the shortfall while selecting the kit.
The shortfall is an ungated draft. The check names accepted packing note v1 and does not rewrite it. The commit writes that version and does not edit it. The kit list is not sent outside.
No focal incremental hours. Exceptions stay inside the check. System upkeep is the item-code map only.
unknowns: Whether required kit counts are stored as fields or only as protocol prose.
research_questions: Which competition kits have item codes and counts today, and which are still prose?

already_counted.description: Reading the packed kit against the sites and the shortfall, inside the check.

incremental.description: Map item code, required count, and stored count for the shortfall.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when the protocol has no stored counts, so no shortfall is drafted. High is 3 when the shortfall and the commit run and selecting the kit stays in full. Central net is the shortfall plus the commit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct research in the prevention or treatment of injuries or medical conditions related to sports and exercise.

steps.what: Discuss prevention research on sports injuries with co-investigators
Read mail about treatment of medical conditions in sports
Read stored citation fields on the research record
Read papers on prevention and treatment of sports injuries
Draft a citation brief that copies stored title and year
State the research finding on these sports injuries
Check the research finding against the papers and the brief
Commit the accepted research note without changing the finding

tasks.design: The research record in {OTHER} stores citation title and year, and a draft copies those fields into a brief in {DOCS}. The sports medicine physician still states the finding. A later check accepts the research note, and a separate step commits that version.
tasks.previous_blocker: The citation line and the finding sat in one note, so a copy of title and year would also have stated the conclusion.
tasks.enabler_now: Title and year can be copied as fields. Stating the finding stays a separate human step.
tasks.still_hard: Many citations are still free text. A missing title or year means no brief is drafted.
tasks.human_edge: Only the sports medicine physician can state what the study shows. The citation brief does not do that.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays with the discussion and with stating the finding. Less time goes to retyping title and year. No new right to conclude a study.

reach.task: Keep citation fields for a sports injury study
reach.learn: Which stored title and year a brief may copy, and which finding the physician must still state.

evidence.claim: A citation brief can copy a stored title and year. That copy does not state the research finding.
Health data are special-category data, and a data-protection assessment is expected when a study holds them.
A decision based solely on automated processing needs a legal basis. The physician states the finding before the research note is committed.
Works-council consent applies when staff performance is recorded. The research discussion is not recorded.

assumptions: Floors left three points, which went to spreadsheets, meetings, and documents. The spreadsheet prior is folded into screens because the study counts live on the research record.

The sports medicine physician writes the brief and states the finding today, so every step's actor is the sports medicine physician. The machine is only the future fate of the brief and of the commit.
Co-investigators join the discussion. Their time is not a step in this task. The discussion is not sent out and is not recorded.
The record step produces citation title and year. If those are free text, the physician types the brief while stating the finding.
The brief is an ungated draft. The check names accepted research note v1 and does not rewrite it. The commit writes that version and does not edit it. The note is not published outside.
No focal incremental hours. Exceptions stay inside the check. System upkeep is the citation-field map only.
unknowns: Whether this research record stores title and year as fields or only inside the paper text.
research_questions: Which citation fields are discrete today, and which studies still hold health data that need an assessment?

already_counted.description: Reading the finding against the papers and the brief, inside the check.

incremental.description: Map citation title and year for the brief.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when title and year are not stored fields, so no brief is drafted. High is 6 when the brief and the commit run and stating the finding stays in full. Central net is the brief plus the commit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise athletes on ways that substances, such as herbal remedies, could affect drug testing results.

steps.what: Read the athlete mail that names the herbal remedies
Read stored medicines named for these athletes
Read the vetted text that states each paragraph
Draft advice sentences that each cite one vetted paragraph

loop.input: Vetted paragraph ids and the herbal remedies named in the mail.
loop.output: Advice sentences, each citing one paragraph id.
loop.check: A sentence with no paragraph id is dropped.
loop.stop: One pass. If no sentence remains, the draft is empty.
loop.why_not_simpler: A stored medicine list cannot say how a herbal remedy affects a test.

steps.what: Advise athletes how substances could affect testing results
Check whether each sentence matches its paragraph and this athlete
Commit the accepted substance advice for these athletes

tasks.design: A vetted patient text in {DOCS} is the only source for advice sentences, and each sentence must cite one paragraph. The sports medicine physician still advises the athletes in the room. A later check accepts the sentences for this athlete, and a separate step commits that version on {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice and the source paragraph sat in one spoken answer, so a draft could not keep a sentence without also deciding it fitted this athlete.
tasks.enabler_now: A vetted text can be split into paragraph ids. Matching a sentence to this athlete stays a separate human check.
tasks.still_hard: A remedy with no paragraph in the vetted text yields an empty draft. The physician then advises with no drafted sentence.
tasks.human_edge: Only the sports medicine physician can say what this athlete should hear. A cited sentence does not clear a test.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays with advising the athlete in the room. Less time goes to writing sentences that already have a paragraph. No new right to clear a test or to prescribe a medicine.

reach.task: Match a substance question to a vetted paragraph
reach.learn: Which paragraph id a sentence may cite, and which advice the physician must still give this athlete.

evidence.claim: Thuisarts publishes guideline-based patient text.
Each advice sentence is kept only when it cites a paragraph id from text already read, and personal advice is accepted by the physician before it is committed.
The medicines act defines a prescription as a recept. This advice does not create a recept.
Providers are responsible for careful use of generative AI, including whether it is a medical device and medication errors from wrong registration.
A decision based solely on automated processing needs a legal basis. The physician advises in the room and accepts the note before it is committed.
A patient dossier is kept twenty years after the last change. The committed advice sits in that dossier.
Health data are special-category data, and a data-protection assessment is expected before the advice note is committed.
Works-council consent applies when staff performance is recorded. The advice room is not recorded.

assumptions: Means summed to 99.9. The leftover points went to documents, then meetings, then screens. The 0.3 spreadsheet remainder did not round up, so this task has no spreadsheet step.

The sports medicine physician writes the sentences and advises the athlete today, so every step's actor is the sports medicine physician. The machine is only the future fate of the sentences and of the commit.

The vetted-text step produces paragraph id and paragraph text. The record step produces the medicine names already stored for these athletes. If a remedy has no paragraph id, that sentence is dropped and the physician advises without it.

No written advice is sent out. The athlete hears it in the room. The sentences are an ungated draft. The check names accepted substance advice v1 and does not rewrite it. The commit writes that version and does not edit it.
No focal incremental hours. Rewriting a dropped sentence stays inside the check. System upkeep is the paragraph-id map only.
unknowns: Which vetted text this service uses, and whether its paragraphs already have stable ids.
research_questions: Which herbal remedies have a paragraph in the vetted text, and which advice notes already sit in the athlete dossier?

already_counted.description: Reading each sentence against its paragraph and this athlete, inside the check.

incremental.description: Map paragraph id and paragraph text for the advice sentences.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when the vetted text has no paragraph ids, so no sentence is kept. High is 10 when the sentences and the commit run and the in-person advice stays in full. Central net is the sentences plus the commit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and prescribe exercise programs, such as off-season conditioning regimens.

steps.what: Examine the athlete before an off-season conditioning program
Read mail that asks for off-season conditioning regimens
Read stored training rows on the athlete record
Read the off-season protocol that names the regimens
Draft an off-season block by copying stored protocol rows
Develop and prescribe exercise programs for this athlete
Check exercise programs against the exam and the protocol
Commit the accepted exercise program on the athlete record

tasks.design: The off-season protocol in {DOCS} lists weeks, sessions, and exercise names. A draft copies those rows into a dated block and does not choose. The sports medicine physician still develops and prescribes the exercise programs after the examination, a later check accepts that program, and a separate step commits it on {OTHER}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The protocol rows and the prescribed program sat in one note, so copying the rows would also have chosen the program.
tasks.enabler_now: Weeks, sessions, and exercise names can be copied as rows. Prescribing the program stays a separate human step.
tasks.still_hard: Many protocols are prose without rows. A missing row means no block is drafted.
tasks.human_edge: Only the sports medicine physician can prescribe the program for this athlete. The copied block does not do that.
tasks.altitude: The same time stays with the examination and with prescribing the program. Less time goes to retyping protocol rows. No new right to choose the program.

reach.task: Compare a conditioning protocol with the prescribed program
reach.learn: Which protocol rows a block may copy, and which program the physician must still prescribe.

evidence.claim: Copying stored protocol rows into a dated block does not choose or prescribe the exercise program.
The medicines act defines a prescription as a recept. An exercise program is not that recept and is not sent to a pharmacy.
A decision based solely on automated processing needs a legal basis. The physician prescribes the program before it is committed.
A patient dossier is kept twenty years after the last change. The committed program sits in that dossier.
Health data are special-category data, and a data-protection assessment is expected before the program is committed.
Works-council consent applies when staff performance is recorded. The examination is not recorded.

assumptions: Floors left two points, which went to mail and then to screens. The spreadsheet prior is folded into screens because the training-load numbers live on the athlete record.

The sports medicine physician writes the block and prescribes the program today, so every step's actor is the sports medicine physician. The machine is only the future fate of the block and of the commit.
The protocol step produces week, session, and exercise name. The record step produces the stored training rows. If the protocol is prose, the physician types the block while prescribing.

The block is an ungated draft and does not choose the program. The check names accepted exercise program v1 and does not rewrite it. The commit writes that version and does not edit it. The program is not sent to a pharmacy.
No focal incremental hours. Exceptions stay inside the check. System upkeep is the protocol-row map only.
unknowns: Whether off-season protocols store week, session, and exercise name as rows or only as prose.
research_questions: Which conditioning protocols are discrete rows today, and which programs already sit in the athlete dossier?

already_counted.description: Reading the programs against the exam and the protocol, inside the check.

incremental.description: Map week, session, and exercise name for the off-season block.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low is zero when the protocol has no stored rows, so no block is drafted. High is 6 when the block and the commit run and prescribing stays in full. Central net is the block plus the commit.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The same time stays with the athlete and with selecting the kit, stating the research finding, advising on a substance, and prescribing the program. Less time goes to retyping shortfalls, citation fields, vetted sentences, and protocol rows. No new right to choose the kit, conclude a study, clear a test, or choose the program.
skills_to_grow: Confirm stored counts, citation fields, paragraph ids, and protocol rows before a draft runs.
Refuse a kit note, a finding, a substance note, or a program when the stored fields do not match the athlete or the protocol.
role.ambitious_version: The sports medicine physician could open the sideline visit with the shortfall and the protocol block already beside the record, and still choose the kit and the program in the room.
